subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing and actionable in these expense records.

judge.implied_focus: Characterizing IT asset/spend expenses — what each expense record is buying (asset type, brand, spend category) and how it flows through the process

per_column.name: asset_category
per_column.rationale: Directly types the purchased asset, a core facet of what the spend is for.

per_column.name: asset_brand
per_column.rationale: Vendor/brand dimension of the asset, an actionable facet for spend analysis.

per_column.name: spend_type
per_column.rationale: Classifies the nature of the expenditure (hardware vs travel vs cloud), central to the focus.

per_column.name: travel_flag
per_column.rationale: Redundant with spend_type's travel value but still consistent with the spend-classification focus.

per_column.name: asset_lifecycle_action
per_column.rationale: Frames the expense within asset lifecycle, adding a coherent process facet.

per_column.name: record_origin
per_column.rationale: Data-provenance metadata; drifts from the asset/spend focus toward data-quality.

per_column.name: processing_lag_band
per_column.rationale: Processing-time facet that is actionable for operational analysis of expenses.

per_column.name: has_source_id
per_column.rationale: Bare null-presence flag; a generic data-completeness check, not part of the spend focus.

per_column.name: high_volume_user_flag
per_column.rationale: Segments spenders by volume, an actionable analytic angle on expense records.

judge.rationale: The bulk of the columns cohere around a single inferable focus: characterizing what IT-asset expense records are buying (asset_category, asset_brand, spend_type, asset_lifecycle_action) plus operational/segmentation facets (processing_lag_band, high_volume_user_flag, travel_flag). This is a genuine, actionable framing an analyst could pursue for spend optimization. Structure is multi-faceted at a useful granularity rather than a single restatement. It is held back from a top score by mild redundancy (travel_flag duplicates spend_type's travel_expense) and two provenance/completeness columns (record_origin, has_source_id) that read as generic data-quality checks pulling slightly away from the spend focus. Overall a coherent, non-trivial inferred focus with minor scatter.
